name: 35640 · Hartselle, AL
findings: ZIP 35640 (Hartselle) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35640 (Hartselle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
